# diff

# version
# Betaflight / STM32F7X2 (S7X2) 4.4.3 Nov 18 2023 / 01:52:14 (738127e7e) MSP API: 1.45

# config: YES

# start the command batch
batch start

board_name MAMBAF722_2022A
manufacturer_id DIAT

# feature
feature GPS

# serial
serial 20 1 115200 57600 0 115200

# master
set dshot_bidir = ON
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT300

profile 2

# profile 2
set p_pitch = 50
set d_pitch = 48
set d_roll = 42
set f_roll = 110
set d_min_roll = 28

rateprofile 1

# rateprofile 1
set rates_type = BETAFLIGHT
set roll_rc_rate = 120
set pitch_rc_rate = 120
set yaw_rc_rate = 100
set roll_expo = 10
set pitch_expo = 10
set roll_srate = 72
set pitch_srate = 72
set yaw_srate = 60
set yaw_rate_limit = 1000
set roll_level_expo = 20

# end the command batch
batch end
